name: Hasegawa Ai
source:
The mother of the protagonist (Shingo).
She's a rough-and-tumble person, but she cares for Shingo, hence why she's so strict with him.
With a rejuvenated body, she wants to enjoy her youth again.

[translated from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_235.html#character]official website[/url]]
